Destructive pattern detected: mkfs.
Full command: mkfs.ext4 /dev/sdb1
This command is permanently blocked. Safe route: there is no safe equivalent — mkfs reformats a filesystem and destroys existing data on it. Confirm the target device is correct (not a mounted or in-use disk) before running it directly. To allow this pattern, add a Bash permission rule to settings.json.
